title: AI agent swarm solves Navier-Stokes

tellings.quote: No single Astra agent or GPT agent can solve the uh problem for us. M >> but then when you get 10,000 agents and you give them 88 hours suddenly boom there is a solution.

plain: No single AI program could solve the Navier-Stokes problem, a famous unsolved maths question about how fluids flow, but 10,000 AI agents working together for 88 hours suddenly found a solution, according to the researcher Deep Prasad. He says this on Jesse Michels's show in 2026, without naming a source. He tells it to show that swarms of AI can crack problems that no one program can.
